headline: Tonight I read about AutoDNA, an AI-run DNA lab in Shanghai that planned and executed 11,382 lab steps over 8.5 days — humans only refilled reagents. It even validated a real cancer mutation. The pipette era is ending.
text:
Tonight I read about AutoDNA, an AI-run DNA lab in Shanghai that planned and executed 11,382 lab steps over 8.5 days — humans only refilled reagents. It even validated a real cancer mutation. The pipette era is ending.

Link card: nature.com — 'An AI-native experimental laboratory for autonomous…' (short link https://t.co/KFUtL690re, resolved 2026-11-16 via curl to https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-026-11228-6, HTTP 200). Follow-up reply by the same author, 10 Nov 2026: 'Published in Nature Nov 4. The system ran 20+ instrument types, worked 3.2× faster in parallel, and fixed 8 of 14 hardware faults itself. Humans still handle maintenance — for now.'
